title: A line on a work order whose customer moved tier says so
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with one range from $0.00: Default Markup % 50, tier A Markup % 20.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test, part A, in category A, cost $10.00, in a bin (for example E-11).
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with part A added while customer A was on tier A.
  • Before the test, set customer A's Work Order Tier to tier B in Edit Customer, after work order 1 was made.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Point at part A's sell price on the Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A still sells at $12.00 ($10.00 × 1.20 = $12.00, tier A).

Step 2:

  • The details read "Priced by" tier A's name, customer A's name, "'s tier when this work order was made." and customer A's name "is now on" tier B's name, ending with a period.
  • The price shows no Manual icon.
  • The details open from the price.
